QF.id: VIII Introduction to Clearing and Settlement System_42

question.text: The Liquid Net Worth requirement for every clearing member / self-clearing member in the F&O segment is:

answer.text: Rs. 50 lakhs, with liquid assets/initial margins permitted in the form of cash, bank guarantees, fixed deposits, approved securities and similar collateral
Rs. 1 crore in government securities only

explanation.text: The Logic: The source specifies a Liquid Net Worth of Rs. 50 lakhs for every clearing member / self-clearing member. Separately, liquid assets and initial margins may be furnished in the form of cash, bank guarantees, fixed deposits, approved securities and similar collateral, subject to the clearing corporation's prescribed haircuts and composition norms. The Trap: The Rs. 50 lakhs figure is the Liquid Net Worth requirement, not "Base Minimum Capital" - the term BMC is not used by the source for this requirement. Note: Source: NISM-Series-VIII workbook (Dec 2025), pages 180-181.
